title: String concatenation in loops
summary: Building large strings with repeated + or fmt.Sprintf in loops.
rationale: Repeated string construction allocates and copies data, especially in exporters and serializers.

detection.notes: Detect +=, +, or fmt.Sprintf in loops that grow output.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use strings.Builder, bytes.Buffer, preallocation, or streaming encoders.
remediation.tradeoffs: For tiny strings, readability may outweigh optimization.

pattern.title: String concatenation in loops
pattern.description: Building large strings with repeated + or fmt.Sprintf in loops.

remediation.title: Reduce avoidable work
remediation.description: Use strings.Builder, bytes.Buffer, preallocation, or streaming encoders.
